gl_ai.subtitle: 話すだけでルーターを設定
gl_ai.empty_title: 何を変えたいか教えてください
gl_ai.empty_desc: WiFi、帯域制限、端末のブロック、遅延の原因調査 — 普通の言葉でどうぞ。
gl_ai.advanced_hint: Leave these alone unless you need them
gl_ai.stream_hint: Ask the model to stream. Unstable on some networks, so it is off by default; replies still appear progressively without it.
gl_ai.verify_tls_hint: Guest and hotel networks often intercept TLS with a self-signed certificate. Turning this off is what lets the router connect there. It lowers connection security.
